title: Framework v2 Operational Scorecard — Board J
authority: All S352 Boards A–I. SESSION350_V1_BASELINE.json. SESSION206_V2_ACTIVATION_REPORT.json.
purpose: Synthesis scorecard answering the five strategic questions. Did v2 improve operations? Produce the S352 Executive Decision Record.

question_1_is_v2_delivering_measurable_g.answer: YES — in scanning. NO — in certification.
question_1_is_v2_delivering_measurable_g.detail: Framework v2 is delivering massive gains in the area where it is operationally active: automated scanning. The 0.7s full-pipeline scan replaces ~10.75 hours of estimated v1 manual grep-based per-defect-class scanning — a ~55,000× improvement in time and a categorical improvement in accuracy (0% false positives vs. ~75% in v1). Artifact reuse is proven at 32 board consumptions per scan. However, the gains that matter for delivery velocity — pre-flight defect prevention, delta review, board consolidation — have produced ZERO realized gain because no v2 certification wave has run. The infrastructure is operationally proven but the enforcement is not yet active.
question_1_is_v2_delivering_measurable_g.confidence: HIGH (scan data). MEDIUM (certification projection — depends on unexecuted v2 wave).

question_2_is_readiness_leakage_falling.answer: YES — but not from v2. From manual remediation.
question_2_is_readiness_leakage_falling.detail: Readiness failure rate dropped from 89.5% (v1 baseline) to 6.93% certified pool defect leakage. This -82% reduction came from ~200 sessions of manual remediation (DL-008 sweeps, DL-013 remediation, DL-025/026 distractor authoring, certification waves). Framework v2 pre-flight gates have contributed zero to this reduction because they operate in advisory mode — no certification wave has been blocked or flagged by v2 gates. The remaining 154 leakage items (DL-021: 95, DL-016: 58, DL-034: 1 resolved) would all be caught by v2 enforcement gates IF enforcement were active, but enforcement is not active.
question_2_is_readiness_leakage_falling.confidence: HIGH (leakage counts are verified). MEDIUM (whether v2 gates will actually prevent leakage — depends on enforcement activation).

question_3_is_delta_review_working.detail: The delta review classification engine correctly classified all 2,540 items as NO_CHANGE (100% determinism, zero false classifications). SHA-256 content hashing is reliable and metadata-immune. All 5 inheritance rules (IR-001 through IR-005) are logically specified and unambiguous. However, delta review has zero operational application because: (a) the baseline scan (S206) is from a read-only session — no content changes to review, (b) all 2,540 items are NO_CHANGE (expected for a session with zero content modifications), (c) no certification wave has produced content changes that would trigger IR-002 through IR-005 routing. The engine is ready. The data to prove it is deferred to S811+.
question_3_is_delta_review_working.confidence: HIGH (engine verification). LOW (inheritance routing — has never been applied to real content changes).

question_4_is_scan_reuse_working.detail: The S322 scan artifact has been consumed by 4 sessions (S206, S207, S351, S352) across 32 board analyses. Artifact creation cost: 0.7s. Reuse factor: 32 consumptions from 1 scan. This validates the 'Scan Once, Consume Many' architectural pattern. In v1, every session performed independent ad-hoc scans (0 reuse). In v2, scans are produced once and consumed downstream. Artifact consumption contracts (5 boards consuming specific artifact fields) are validated. Scan redundancy (50+ v1 events) is eliminated.

question_5_is_hybrid_deployment_performi.detail: Hybrid Mode (v1 authoritative, v2 advisory) has been operating since S206 without a single conflict, drift event, or governance violation. Zero certification changes (all 2,221 Certified items retain their state). Zero governance changes (governance-guard 27/27 PASS stable). Zero content changes (all pack file hashes match S351 baseline). Zero S320-class identity failures. The v2 pipeline produces measurement data consumed by analytics sessions; the v1 pipeline continues normal operation. The coexistence model is proven stable. Transition to enforcement mode (S830 P1 exit gate) requires only governance rule activation — no technical changes needed.
question_5_is_hybrid_deployment_performi.confidence: HIGH (proven across S206, S207, S351, S352 — 4 read-only sessions with zero conflicts).

decision_1_baseline_preservation.question: Is the S350 baseline preserved and continuous through S352?
decision_1_baseline_preservation.answer: YES. All 15 hashes match S351. S350_V1_BASELINE.json has not been modified. All 38 frozen metrics intact.

decision_2_identity_operational.question: Is identity resolution operationally effective at Wave 1?
decision_2_identity_operational.answer: YES. 99.96% resolution rate. 0% false positives. 0 S320-class failures since activation. This is the single confirmed operational gain of Framework v2.

decision_3_gate_neg1_operational.question: Is Gate -1 performing as specified at Wave 1?
decision_3_gate_neg1_operational.answer: YES — within scope. Steps 1-3 fully operational (QID format, CC presence, pack attribution). Steps 4-5 deferred per design. 99.96% pass rate. Zero certified-pool items blocked.

decision_4_readiness_leakage.question: Is readiness leakage measurable at Wave 1?
decision_4_readiness_leakage.answer: YES — but not yet actionable. 154 items (6.93%) in certified pool with known defects. Reduction from 89.5% is from manual remediation. v2 gates have prevented zero leakage because they are advisory. Domains E (59.76%) and F (60.16%) are the primary readiness drag.

decision_5_scan_artifact_proven.question: Is the 'Scan Once, Consume Many' pattern working?
decision_5_scan_artifact_proven.answer: YES — proven operationally. 1 artifact → 32 board consumptions across 4 sessions. 100% consumption rate. Elimination of v1's 50+ scan redundancy.

decision_6_delta_engine_ready.question: Is the delta ledger engine reliable?
decision_6_delta_engine_ready.answer: YES. 100% determinism. 2,540/2,540 correctly classified. But effectiveness cannot yet be measured — no certification wave has produced content changes between comparison baselines. First actionable delta: S811+.

decision_7_recommendation_pipeline.question: Is the recommendation pipeline operational?
decision_7_recommendation_pipeline.answer: YES — infrastructure operational with 4 REC-IDs, 2,105 QIDs linked. But pipeline velocity is zero: 0 assigned, 0 in progress, 0 closed. All await S811 assignment.

decision_8_investigation_capability.question: What is the current investigation capability maturity?
decision_8_investigation_capability.answer: LEVEL 2 (Structured Index) — 5 link types operational, 35 challenges, 2,540 indexed items. Distance to target Level 5: 3 levels. Lowest-cost next step: programmatic query layer → Level 3 (1 session, ~100 lines).

decision_9_throughput_claim_restraint.question: Should S352 claim throughput gains?
decision_9_throughput_claim_restraint.answer: PARTIALLY. Scan throughput gains (~55,000×) are measured and verified. Certification throughput gains (1.5-3.8× target) are NOT measured — 0% realized. The 0.7s scan is real; the 3.8× certification multiplier is architectural projection. S352 must not claim what it cannot measure.

decision_10_hybrid_mode_certified.question: Is Hybrid Mode (v1 authoritative, v2 advisory) performing as expected?
decision_10_hybrid_mode_certified.answer: YES — EXCEEDING EXPECTATIONS. 4 read-only sessions (S206, S207, S351, S352) with zero conflicts, zero drift, zero governance violations. v1 continues normal operations. v2 produces measurement data. Coexistence model is stable and proven.

session_352_verdict: FRAMEWORK_V2_WAVE_1_MEASUREMENT_COMPLETE — Infrastructure is operationally proven across all 6 engines. Scan throughput is massive and verified. Identity ambiguity (v1's most damaging defect) is eliminated. Artifact reuse is proven. Hybrid Mode is stable. BUT: certification throughput — the metric that matters — is 0% measured because no v2 certification wave has run. The 3.8× multiplier, 80% skip rate, 78% pre-flight detection — all are infrastructure-ready but operationally unrealized. S352 has measured what CAN be measured. S353 and S354 (after S811) will measure what MUST be measured.
